scope: Completed RL4 r2; log counts plus CPU validator probes, not new games or independent learning evaluation

B_adjacent_feedback_pairs.definition: Within each episode, compare consecutive feedback-bearing answers, normalizing digits in the first reason line. Ordinary answers may intervene; not a per-command failure probability or correction success rate.

B_gas_choice_probes.validator_probe_method: test_original_bo_segment.frozen_source(runtime_sha) + test_r6_format_reward.strict_validator; SC2_ORIGINAL_BO_SEGMENT=1, legacy, segment/bullet env values6; no runtime mutation
B_gas_choice_probes.limits: Membership acceptance is not actual construction. No claim that every gas-short observation requires an additional refinery or that refinery must always be the first action.
